body.name: Masked studentized interval
body.construction:
Set \(
u_M=|\Omega_0|-r(N+T-r)=NT-n_1t_1-r(N+T-r)\). For \(
u_M>0\), use the nonnegative root \(\widehat\sigma_M=[
u_M^{-1}\sum_{(i,t)\in\Omega_0}(Y_{it}-\widehat L_{M,it})^2]^{1/2}\), and set it to zero otherwise. Return \(\mathrm{CI}_M=[\widehat{\operatorname{ATT}}_M\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\widehat\sigma_M/\sqrt{n_1t_1}]\).
